trajectory_summary: The call opens warm but the rep never runs a structured qualification — verify items are skipped wholesale and the rep discovers mid-call, reactively, that this is an existing 10kW solar customer looking for battery backup. It ends in a DQ delivered awkwardly after a hold, with the customer's earlier signal (duplicate quote, too-high price) never resolved.
